description:
We love Toffifee (however you pronounce it ;)) and what better way to show it than by making it in to ice cream....

This is a flavour LOVED by the community we are active in and is now sold in Singapore, if you want to show some love to Munira @ I Scream SG, check out her Instagram page : https://www.instagram.com/i.scream.sg/

To make this ice cream you'll need:
300ml Milk
400ml Double (Heavy) Cream
180g Sugar
1-2 Tbsp Dulche de Leche (save rest for the swirl)
100g Hazelnut Milk Chocolate

Please use a larger pan than I did 😂 and remember, this is a high sugar recipe so let it churn for longer.

We hope you enjoy not only making it, but eating this flavour too. 
If you want to know the much more complicated version of this with a "no freeze" caramel sauce etc, make sure to let us know so we can show it to you. 

If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)
